remarks: Welcome to your new home! This spacious 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offers modern living with the convenience of an attached garage and an open layout. The end-unit design provides extra privacy, and you'll love the slider that opens to a deck, perfect for grilling and outdoor relaxation.  Inside, enjoy the convenience of in-unit washer/dryer, gas heat, and a pull-down attic for extra storage. The open floor plan is ideal for entertaining, while the primary bedroom features a private ensuite bath for added comfort. The kitchen is well-equipped and flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas.  Pets are welcome, so bring your furry friends along. This condo townhouse is in a great commuter location, with easy access to highways and just a short walk to the train station.
